title: American Express paid Delta more than Delta's whole pre-tax profit

hook.a: American Express paid Delta more last year than Delta made in pre-tax profit.
hook.b: Delta's best customer might be a credit card.

numbers.label: American Express remuneration 2025
numbers.value: $8.2 billion, up ~11% on 2024; Delta expects $10 billion over the next few years

numbers.label: Income before income taxes 2025
numbers.value: $6,185M (2024: $4,658M); operating revenue $63,364M; operating income $5,822M; total passenger revenue $51,768M vs $50,894M in 2024 (+2%)

scenes.vo: [flat, confident] American Express paid Delta eight point two billion dollars last year.
scenes.sub: paid by American Express to Delta, 2025

scenes.vo: Delta's whole pre-tax profit was six point two.
scenes.title: Delta, 2025, $B

scenes.vo: [matter-of-fact] Amex buys SkyMiles to hand out on its Delta cards.
[lowered, teasing] So is Delta really an airline or a bank partner?
Every swipe on a Delta card earns miles,
and Amex pays Delta for them.
[steady] That's about thirteen percent of all Delta's revenue.
Delta says it wants ten billion a year from Amex.
[calm, sure] The seat is the product you see.
scenes.text: The seat is what you see

scenes.vo: [quiet, knowing] The card is the one that pays.
